title: G-every-fact: one procedure (G-self-citation, seed 4) against every established fact
method: One period-plausible procedure, fitted on the 192 public practice train pages only, writes meaningless text shaped like the 34 practice eval pages (same ids, sections, line lengths). The procedure is the pinned G-self-citation generator (see vs/generators.py): it uses only the training vocabulary and statistics, no manuscript text beyond the fit, no target patterns, and no hidden pages.
